description: Reduce what a connector's tools may do: turn tools off, or end their Always allow setting by setting them back to ask. Allow in this chat grants of single chats are not changed. It can never turn a tool on, grant Always allow, or switch the connector itself on; those stay in the Besidka app. Every tool name must belong to the connector, or nothing changes. Returns the updated tool list. Requires signing in (connectors:write).

tools.description: Up to 100 tools to change, each with enabled: false, approval: "ask" or both

approval.description: ask ends the Always allow setting of the tool, so it asks again. Granting Always allow is only possible in the Besidka app

enabled.description: false turns the tool off. Turning a tool on is only possible in the Besidka app

name: update_connector_tools
title: Restrict connector tools
